The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

The First Few Turns i can get out every location in the deck, in about two turns most of the time. The deck is centered on space control (yes..despite having four ships)....they are relatively cheap and good for the objective. Hold the space and drain..since most dark side space cant win (and if against the bounty in ships, i use something like out of nowhere for extra attrition power along with the multiple battle destinies.)

Drain in space, deploy on ground for fodder(Ral Captains are forfeit of 5 regularly, 7 if at Karrde's site) ICBW for drain prevention and general force loss prevention. Characters deploy at Docking bays and either force drain there unopposed, or lose some characters to cycling Fallen Portals.

Basically a prevent deck that doesnt Kessel Run.
